Commentary.Commentary: The fourth innings is set to begin. England have to chase down 296 with four sessions in hand. Can they remain unscathed at the end of Day 4? We shall find out soon as the Kiwi players take the field. Followed by Alex Lees and Zak Crawley who walk out to open for England. Trent Boult to start with the ball.
... Day 4, Session 3 ...

Now, England will start their chase with the belief that they can chase anything as that is the form their batters are in. The wicket though is not an easy one, it is turning and there is something in it for the pacers so the Kiwis will back themselves to do well with the ball. Join us for the reply in a bit…
For England, Leach was brilliant and Potts yet again impressed. The two bowled long spells and got wickets when the game was drifting away. The two had 8 scalps between them.

New Zealand will be slightly disappointed with how things went along in this session. They were in a really good position to stretch their lead to over 300 but that hasn been their story in this game, they have lost wickets in heaps and it was the same here. From 274 for 5 they have bundled out for 326. Still though they must feel they have got quite a lot of runs on the board and it is because of contributions from Williamson, Latham, Blundell and Mitchell. However, there were hardly any runs from the rest and that will be something the visitors will be disappointed with.

It is Leach who leads his team off the field and why not? He has been exceptional. 5 wickets in this innings and 10 wickets in the whole game. A really commendable effort but England have a stiff target ahead of them as they have to chase down 296 runs.

OUT! BOWLED! This is on off and fuller with some turn, Trent Boult dances down the track to swing at it but misses. The ball kisses the middle pole and that ends the innings for New Zealand. Jack Leach gets his second 5-wicket haul of the game and the first 10-wicket haul of his Test career! All the English players surround him and rejoice at his achievement. Tom Blundell walks off to a standing ovation for his unbeaten knock and Jack Leach follows him off the ground he loves so much! The players will take Tea on Day 4!
FOUR! Trent Boult gets this one away! He gives the bowler the charge and catches the ball on the full at his pads. Clobbers this one square of mid-wicket for his first boundary!
FOUR! Tom Blundell with an innovative shot this time! Slightly full outside off, the batter moves way outside off stump and goes low to paddle this over Sam Billings for a boundary!
Back-of-a-length delivery going doing the leg side, Tom Blundell tries to glance this but misses.
FOUR! What wonderful placement from Tom Blundell! Fraction short angling into the batter, Tom Blundell makes room and pierces the two fielders at deep point and fine leg for a boundary.
Full and angling into the pads, Tom Blundell works it to square leg.
Strays down leg stump this time on a good length. Tom Blundell leaves this one alone.
Good-length delivery on middle. Tom Blundell gets across the stumps and defends it back to the bowler.
Full on the pads, Defended towards square leg.

This one lands outside off, Trent Boult steps out and tries to defend it but gets an inside edge back on his pads. Jack Leach thought it had hit his pads and makes an appeal but the umpire was not interested.
Chance for Joe Root at slips! Full and outside off, Trent Boult defends and gets a thick edge towards the diving slip fielder. Does not manage to keep an hold of it.
Full angling into the pads, Trent Boult charges and gets an inside edge towards backward square leg.
Middle stump line on a good length. Trent Boult plays it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery on off. Worked towards point.
FOUR! This one is perfectly timed. Fuller and on off, Tom Blundell uses his feet and drives it past covers for another boundary.
Shorter one on off, Tom Blundell looks to play at it but misses. Wide called.
FOUR! This one lands on middle, Tom Blundell dances down the track and steers it past covers for a boundary.
This is on off and on a length, Tom Blundell blocks it towards slips.
Goes fuller and down the leg side, Blundell looks to flick it but the ball hits his pads and rolls toward the vacant short leg region.
On a length and on off, Tom Blundell blocks it away.
Shorter and on middle, Tom Blundell pulls is towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Trent Boult is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Not the prettiest of catches but he has managed to hang onto that one! This one is flighted full outside off, Neil Wagner plays at it and gets a thick edge to the keeper. Sam Billings does not get it in his gloves but uses his thighs to clasp the ball. Pulls it out from between his legs like a bunny from the hat and appeals loudly! The umpire wants to check if the catch is caught cleanly and informs that the soft signal is out. The replays go in favour of England and another man departs for New Zealand.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Billings b Jack Leach

Commentary.Commentary: Is that caught behind? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The soft signal is OUT. The UltraEdge confirms that the bat is involved. Later it confrms that Sam Billings gathered the ball cleanly in between his legs. The big screen shows OUT and Headingley has come back to life.
Fuller and on middle, Neil Wagner eases it back towards the bowler.
Jack Leach bowls it just outside off, Neil Wagner looks to drive it but misses. That was close to the stumps.
This one land on off, Neil Wagner defends it solidly.
Outside off this time, Neil Wagner defends it to the short cover fielder.
Neil Wagner is the new man in.

OUT! Jack Leach is having a wonderful Test match here! slightly full on middle, turns off the surface, and keeps its line. Tim Southee tries to defend and has a massive gap between bat and pad. The ball goes through that gap and castles him all ends up. Two more wickets left and England will be hoping to end this innings as soon as possible!
On off, defended out.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Tom Blundell dances down the track and looks to pull it but misses. The ball goes past his bat and stumps and into the gloves of the keeper. He gets a lucky escape.
This is on off, Tom Blundell drives it but finds the fielder at short cover.
Some extra bounce angling into the batter, Tim Southee looks to block it but the ball hits his glove and rolls towards short fine leg. They rotate the strike.
On a length and on leg, Tim Southee fumbles a bit but defends it in the end.
On a length and outside leg, Tim Southee looks to give it a fine tickle but misses.
Jack Leach bowls it outside off, Tom Blundell guides it towards the fielder at point.
Touch fuller in length and down the middle, Tom Blundell plays it towards the fielder at mid on.
Outside off this time, Tom Blundell eases it towards the vacant silly point region.
FOUR! This one lands outside leg, Tom Blundell sweeps it but gets a bottom edge as the ball races towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, Tom Blundell uses his feet and blocks it away.
On a length with a hint of turn, Tom Blundell looks to defend it but misses.
Matthew Potts bowls it just outside off, Tim Southee looks to defend it but misses.
Slightly shorter and on off, Tim Southee looks to defend it but misses. That was close.
This one lands on a length and outside off, Tom Blundell guides it towards backward point for one.
On a length and down the middle, this is defended towards the mid on fielder.
This is outside off and on a length, Tom Blundell looks to play at it but misses.
On middle, blocked out.
Dropped! This is outside off, Tim Southee looks to play at but gets an outside edge and carries towards the first slip who drops it. A lucky escape for Tim Southee.
On off, this is defended towards the short cover fielder.
On leg, Tom Blundell sweeps it towards backward square leg. The ball was in the air for some time but falls in no man's land. Single taken.
This one lands on middle, Tom Blundell defends it back towards the bowler.
Fuller and outside off, Tom Blundell defends it towards the vacant silly point region.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Tim Southee flicks it towards the leg side and scampers through for a quick single.
Oh, that was close! Fuller and outside off, Tom Blundell looks to drive it but misses. The ball just aired past his bat and into the gloves of the keeper.
On a full length and down the middle, Tom Blundell defends it solidly off his front foot.
This one lands on leg, Tom Blundell flicks it towards square leg for a brace.
On off, defended out.
FOUR! Matthew Potts bowls it on a length outside off, Blundell opens his bat face and late cuts it past the slip cordon for a boundary.
On off, defended towards the leg side.
Tossed up this up outside off, Southee leans forward and drives it aerially at covers. The fielder makes a diving effort but fails to get any hand to it.
This one lands on middle and fuller, Tim Southee eases it towards mid on fielder.
Tossed up on middle, Tim Southee guides it towards the slip fielder.

Drinks break. England are right back in the mix after the two quick wickets. Michael Bracewell could not continue with his attack for long and Kiwis now seem to be in a spot of bother. They would that Blundell is supported well from the other end and remain unscathed until the Tea break. An enticing phase awaits. Also, it will be Tim Southee who walks in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jack Leach strikes and just like in the first innings he picking on the New Zealand tail! This was full and angling into the pads, Michael Bracewell flicks this high towards Zak Crawley at deep square leg who pouches it with ease. Jack Leach raises his arms in celebration as Michael Bracewell was looking to be aggressive!
Commentary.Howout: c Zak Crawley b Jack Leach

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker delivery on middle, Bracewell turns it to short leg.
SIX! Tossed up on off, Michael Bracewell gets on his knees and smashes it over long on for a maximum. That was perfectly timed from Michael Bracewell.

Good-length delivery outside off, Michael Bracewell punches this through cover-point as the ball runs towards the fence for three runs. The ball seemed to be running away from the fielder but he eventually gets there.
Good-length on off, Michael Bracewell knocks it to cover.
Short this time angling into the batter, Tom Blundell pulls this wide of fine leg for a single.
Good length and on the off, Blundell blocks it straight back to the bowler.
A length delivery on the off, Blundell flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and angling down leg, Michael Bracewell tries to flick it and it hits his pad, England players appeal but the umpire in unmoved.
A maiden from Jack Leach. Slightly short on middle, Blundell goes deep in his crease and defends it away.
Full and straight down the middle, Blundell blocks it to the leg side.
Tossed-up delivery on middle, Tom Blundell guides it towards the fielder at mid off.
On the stumps and much fuller, Blundell takes a stride forward and guides it to the off side.
Full on middle, defended back to the bowler.
A full delivery outside off, Blundell plays a front foot defense.
A full one outside off, shaping away. Bracewell decides to leave it.
Slightly shorter delivery on off, Bracewell defends it off the backfoot.
Another length delivery but this time a bit straight, Bracewell blocks it out to the legside.
A length delivery on off, Bracewell plays a solid defense.
BEATEN! A bit fuller on off, shaping away from the left hander. Bracewell tries to drive at it but misses it completely.
A good-length delivery on the leg stump, Blundell flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
On a good-length and on the off, Bracewell blocks it out on the off side.
A bit short, outside off, Blundell cuts it towards deep point for a single.
A length delivery on the off, Blundell goes on the backfoot and pushes it towards covers. He denies for the single.

FOUR! Tossed-up delivery on off, Blundell looks to defend it but gets an outside edge as the ball rolls between the keeper and the first slip fielder for a boundary. The fielder at slips tries to make a diving stop but misses.
Another full delivery on the stumps, Blundell blocks it out.
A full delivery on the stumps, Blundell defends it towards short leg.
A length delivery on off, Bracewell plays a solid front foot defense.
Michael Bracewell is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! This time the review goes in favor of England! Matthew Potts bowls this on a good length outside off, Gets good shape into the batter, as Daryl Mitchell comes across the stumps to work it leg side. Misses the line of the ball and hits him hard on his pads. The umpire says its out once again and Daryl Mitchell reviews this time. There is no edge as confirmed by the UltraEdge and three reds means that the on field decision stays. Daryl Mitchell the man in form trudges back to the pavilion.
A bit fuller in length, on middle and leg, Mitchell drives it straight towards the fielder at mid on.
A good-length delivery on off, Mitchell blocks it out on the off side.
A length delivery on the off, Blundell blocks it on the offside and gets across for a quick single.

NOT OUT! Tom Blundell is saved by the review this time. Full and angling into the pads. Tom Blundell plays all over this one and it thumps against his pads. The umpire raises his finger and Tom Blundell reviews. The Ultra Edge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing the wickets. Yet another decision that favoured England has to be overturned here.
Full and on off. Mitchell defends it to covers on the front foot.
FOUR! Daryl Mitchell growing with confidence now. It is full and outside off. Daryl Mitchell sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
On off, defended out.
Short, around off. Blundell goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Blundell defends it into the deck on the front foot.
Flatter, on the pads, Tom Blundell goes back and tucks it to square leg.
Length, on off. Daryl Mitchell gets behind and blocks.

FOUR! Deft touch! Daryl Mitchell now gets his fifth Test match half century. It is on a good length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell waits for it and guides it down to third man for a boundary. A fielder gives it a chase but in vain.
Outside off, left alone by Daryl Mitchell.
Length, around off, defended back to the bowler.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Off the edge! Full length, in the channel. Daryl Mitchell hangs his blade away from his body and guides it through slip cordon for four. Mitchell gets a bit lucky this time.
Sharp turn! Touch short, outside off. Blundell looks to pull it away but decides against it in the end.
On off, defended out.

GOES PAST SLIPS! This is close. It is tossed up, full and around off. Tom Blundell tries to defend it out on his front foot. He gets a thick outside edge which beates the diving effort of the slip fielder. It races away down to third man for a brace. FIFTY up for Blundell.
Fired down the leg side. Blundell nurdles it to short leg.
Floated and full, around leg. Blundell gets it to the off side.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Blundell nudges it to the leg side.
BEATEN! This is fuller again, on fifth stump. Daryl Mitchell looks to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge. This one also stays a touch low.
Great promotion for Test cricket as the Yorkshire County Cricket Club has provided free tickets for Day 5 of this Test.
Broad dishes it full, in the channel. Daryl Mitchell defends it to covers.
Full length, spraying down leg. Daryl Mitchell flicks it to mid-wicket, unable to get it through the gap.
Fraction short, wide outside off. Tom Blundell punches it to cover for a quick single. He moves to 49.
Good length, in the channel. Blundell defends it into the deck with soft hands.
Outside off, Blundell shows no interest.
On a length, on off. Daryl Mitchell defends it back to the bowler with full face of the blade.
Potts fires it full and outside off. Mitchell uses his feet and drive it straight to covers.
Outside off yet again. Daryl Mitchell has no shot to offer.
Short ball, wide outside off. Daryl Mitchell leaves it alone.
Daryl Mitchell square up a bit and defends this length delivery to point off the outer half.
Angles it in, full and outside off. Blundell digs it out to point and they cross.
Full length, on off. Mitchell comes up with a good solid back to the bowler. Just a single off it. It has been a great start by England so far.
A length ball, on off. Mitchell tries to defend it out but does more off the inner half.
Much fuller, outside off. Mitchell gets behind the line and smothers it towards mid off.
Full length, on fifth stump. Tom Blundell defends it to covers on the front foot and scampers across for a single. He moves to 47.
Fraction short, on off. Blundell stays back and defends it out.

This is close! Broad dishes an inswinger, around off. Blundell tries to drive it down the ground but gets an inside edge. The ball almost goes on to disturb the stumps behind, but Blundell is quick to turn around and keep the ball away.
A great start by Potts, just a run of it. It is around the hips. Blundell clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller length, outside off. Blundell drives it on the up but only manages to find the fielder.
Touch fuller, on fourth stump. Tom Blundell presses forward and blocks it to point. He denies for a single straightaway.
Three dots on the trot! Length ball, on the pads, this one stays a touch low. Blundell blocks it to the on side.
Well wide of off stump. Tom Blundell shows no interest.
Potts goes full and down leg. Blundell tries to flick it away but fails to connect.
A maiden for Broad to start the afternoon session. This is on a good length, in the channel. Daryl Mitchell covers his stumps and lets it go through.
Back of a length, wide outside off. Mitchell leaves it alone.
A stifled appeal for lbw but the umpire is unmoved. This one is angled in on off. Daryl Mitchell stays inside the crease. He fends it out to safety awkwardly.
Broad serves it full and outside off. Mitchell shuffles across and blocks it to the off side.
Fraction short, outside off. Daryl Mitchell shoulders his arms at it.
Full length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell gets behind the line to block it out.

The afternoon session is set to begin. England players stride out to the middle. Followed by Tom Blundell and Daryl Mitchell who walk out with their blades. It will be Stuart Broad to start with the ball.
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

England on the other hand, did not bowl badly but the wicket wasn’t providing a lot of assistance. However, they’ll know it is now when they can not only get back in the game but also turn the tide towards the end. The second new ball is going to be key, the new ball has been the toughest to face and England will want to make use of that. If they don’t, they are well going to be a chasing a big total. Another important session awaits in a bit. Do join us at 1810 IST (1240 GMT) to find out how things pan out.

A top session for New Zealand and they now probably have their noses ahead in this game. Mitchell and Blundell are yet again the saviour for them. They are nearing a 100-run stand and also their respective fifties but they would know they need to bat longer if they are to take their side into a position where they can feel safe.
Slightly short and wide from off stump. Tom Blundell strides forward and leaves the ball in style. That will be Lunch on DAY 4!
Matthew Potts keeps this one outside off and full, Tom Blundell punches it towards cover.
FOUR! Tom Blundell makes the most of the loose delivery! Matthew Potts does not nail his yorker, Tom Blundell flicks the full delivery off his pads through mid-wicket for four runs!
Full once again outside off, Tom Blundell defends it towards cover-point.
Adjusts his length, and pulls it back a bit outside off. Tom Blundell gets his bat down in time as it stays slightly low.
Matthew Potts starts with a full delivery angling into the pads, Daryl Mitchell flicks this wide of square leg for a single.

Stuart Broad is not happy with a landing patch as he runs in for the delivery. He still manages to complete the over as he goes wide of the crease. Well, there is a change in bowling for England, as Matthew Potts comes into the attack.
Fraction back of a length on off, Tom Blundell rises on his toes and plays it back down the pitch. Maiden for Stuart Broad to start of with the new ball!
Full and outside off, does not get swing this time, Tom Blundell defends solidly.

On a length and on off, Tom Blundell blocks it but gets an inside edge and hits his pads. Stuart Broad thinks that it had directly hit his pads and makes a loud appeal but the umpire shows no interest.
Oh, that was close! This one lands a bit lower and just outside off, Tom Blundell looks to defend it but misses.
Another one outside off, Tom Blundell is happy to let it go.
Broad goes outside off and on a good length, Tom Blundell shoulders arms at it.
The second new ball is available now for England. Well, England waste no time in taking the new ball. Time for some pace now, Stuart Broad (19-5-53-0) is back into the attack. He replaces Joe Root.
Flighted full and angling in from off, Daryl Mitchell defends and gets an inside edge towards the leg side.
Faster delivery on a good length outside off. Daryl Mitchell stands tall and punches towards cover.
Full once again on leg, Daryl Mitchell firmly plays it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery slightly wide, Daryl Mitchell goes on the backfoot and works it to point.
Flights this full on middle. Daryl Mitchell defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, Daryl Mitchell works it towards cover.
On middle and leg this time, Blundell flicks that towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Another fuller and down the middle, Tom Blundell with a solid block.
Joe Root bowls it on off, Tom Blundell blocks it towards the vacant silly point region.
Tossed up delivery, Tom Blundell defends it solidly.
On middle again, Tom Blundell eases it towards the mid on fielder.
This one lands fuller and on middle, this is defended back towards Joe Root.
Flighted outside off, Daryl Mitchell comes across the stumps and defends Jack Leach bowls another maiden!
On middle of a good length., Daryl Mitchell plays it back down the pitch.
Fraction fuller on middle. worked towards short mid on.
Good-length delivery on off stump. Daryl Mitchell stands tall and defends.
Full outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets a stride forward and defends solidly.
Flatter delivery on off. Daryl Mitchell smothers it into the pitch.
This one lands fuller, Tom Blundell defends it back towards the bowler.
Close again! On a length and on middle, Tom Blundell looks to defend it but the ball carries towards mid on and just short of the fielder. Tom Blundell gets lucky this time.
Oh, this was close. Fuller and on leg, Daryl Mitchell flicks it towards the leg side. The fielder at short leg had a difficult chance but couldn't get his hands on it. Single taken.
On off again, this is defended back towards the bowler.
This one lands on middle and outside off, Daryl Mitchell eases it towards the mid off fielder.
On off and on a full length, this is blocked out.
Good-length delivery on off. Tom Blundell cuts it towards point.
Flighted on off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Sliding down leg on a good length, Daryl Mitchell misses his flick.
Tossed up on middle and off, Daryl Mitchell defends it towards Jack Leach.
Full once again outside off. defended by Daryl Mitchell.
Full and turning on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Fuller and on the stumps, this is again defended out solidly.
Tossed up delivery, Daryl Mitchell eases it towards the off side for one.
This one lands fuller and on middle, Daryl Mitchell defends it solidly.
FOUR! Outside off and on a length, Daryl Mitchell punches this one through point for four more.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Daryl Mitchell uses his feet and lofts it towards long on for a one-bounce boundary.
Flighted up delivery outside off, Daryl Mitchell defends it towards the off side.
Length delivery outside off, worked to deep cover-point for a single.
Full and angled into the stumps, knocked towards the bowler.
Flighted on off, Daryl Mitchell solid once again.
On a length and on leg, Tom Blundell flicks it towards square leg for one.
Jack Leach bowls it on middle, Tom Blundell guides it towards the off side.
Fuller and on middle, this is defended off the front foot.
This one lands fuller and on middle with some turn, Daryl Mitchell eases it back towards the bowler.
On middle and tossed up, Daryl Mitchell guides it back towards the bowler.
Touch fuler and outside off, this is defended towards the mid off fielder.
Fuller and down the leg side, Daryl Mitchell flicks it towards backward square leg for a brace.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! He tries to reverse sweep it but was slightly early in the shot. It hit the glove and initially was going in the direction of Crawley who was moving to his right at first slip. However, it ended up going past the left of Crawley as it hit the toe-end of the bat in the follow through and goes to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Joe Root begins his spell by being reverse swept! Bowls this full outside off, Daryl Mitchell gets on his knees and connects well enough to find the third man boundary!
Outside off stump and full. Tom Blundell is solid in defense.
Full once again on middle, Tom Blundell gets forward in defense and it falls towards short-leg.
Full and angled into the pads, Tom Blundell drops it down towards short leg.
Full and on off, Daryl Mitchell works it towards cover-point for a single.
Fraction short on off, Tom Blundell goes on his back foot and gets a single to point.
Full outside off, Daryl Mitchell brings his front foot outside the line of the stumps and sweeps it to backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! That goes fine for a boundary! The short deliveries not working as Jamie Overton strays down leg and Tom Blundell gets a bit of bat on it. Runs away to the fine leg boundary for four runs!
Slightly shorter one on off, this is punched towards covers for one.
WIDE! Really short and Daryl Mitchell does not even need to duck for this one. Given wide for height.
Dug in short down leg side, Daryl Mitchell lets this pass through to the keeper.

Good-length delivery pitching outside leg, Daryl Mitchell tries to pull but is not short enough and hits him high on his pads. The ball loops up and Jamie Overton catches it. Initially appeals for LBW and then for a catch, the umpire gives it not out.
Shorter this time on leg, Daryl Mitchell ducks under this one.
Around the wicket on a good length, angling away from Tom Blundell. He taps it down towards cover with soft hands and gets a single.
On a length this time, Blundell makes some room for himself as he cuts it towards point for a single.
This is on middle and fuller, Blundell flicks it towards the leg side and towards the fielder.
Flighted delivery on middle, Blundell strides forward as he defends it solidly.
This is much fuller in length, Tom Blundell defends it back towards the bowler.
On off this time, Tom Blundell blocks it away.
Tossed up on middle with some turn, Tom Blundell goes on his back foot and guides it towards the leg side.
Goes 'round the wicket and bowls a shorter one outside off, Daryl Mitchell ducks under it.
This one lands outside off, Mitchell leaves it alone.
On middle and on a length, this is pulled towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Shorter and on middle, Tom Blundell pulls it hard and towards deep square leg for a boundary.  This brings up 50 runs partnership between Tom Blundell and Daryl Mitchell.
On a length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell guides it towards covers for a quick single.
Shorter and on middle, Tom Blundell pulls it towards backward square leg for one.

NOT OUT! Daryl Mitchell extends his stay in the middle with the help of DRS. It is tossed up, around off. Daryl Mitchell gets on his front foot, tries to block it out but gets beaten and gets pinged on his pads. Leach appeals and the finger goes up. The review is taken. UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing the wickets. Jack Leach is disappointed after looking at the big screen.
On middle this time, Daryl Mitchell blocks it away.
Fuller one and on leg, Daryl Mitchell sweeps it but finds the fielder at square leg.
This one lands on middle, Daryl Mitchell eases it back towards the bowler.
Outside off this time with some turn, Daryl Mitchell looks to block it but misses.
This one lands fuller and outside off, Daryl Mitchell guides it to the mid off fielder.
Change of line. Jamie Overton bowls it outside off this time, Tom Blundell blocks it away.
Another bouncer down the leg side, Tom Blundell leaves it alone. Wide called.
Back of a length this time, Tom Blundell lets it go.
Jamie Overton bowls a bouncer down the middle, Tom Blundell looks to play at it but misses.
On leg and fuller in length, Daryl Mitchell flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter one again, Tom Blundell pulls it this time but finds the fielder at deep square leg. Single taken.
This one lands shorter and outside off, Tom Blundell looks to pull it but misses.

Drinks break. A good first hour for the Kiwis! A wicket less one and they have stretched their lead to over 170. However, the two batting out there will know there’s still a long way to go. They have started well but can they continue the good going? England on the other hand, will hope this break works for them and they manage to get a breakthrough. They have hit the right lines and lengths this morning but not with a any success so far. They need to continue to be patient.
Full on the pads, Daryl Mitchell fends it towards short mid on.
Tossed up on off, Daryl Mitchell punches it straight towards the cover fielder.
Flighted delivery down the middle, Daryl Mitchell defends it on the front foot.

FOUR LEG BYES! That's a jaffa. On middle with some turn, Daryl Mitchell looks to defend it but misses. The keeper misses it s well as the ball races towards the long stop and behind the fence. Unlucky for Jack Leach.
On off this time, Daryl Mitchell eases it towards the off side.
Tossed up on middle, this is blocked back towards the bowler.
Full length, on the pads. Daryl Mitchell nudges it to mid-wicket and steals a single. He will retain the strike.
Back of a length, on off. Daryl Mitchell rides the bounce and pulls it towards square but straight to the fielder.
Length ball, on off. Daryl Mitchell works it towards mid on but denies against the single in the end.
A single now! Short ball, on off. Tom Blundell taps it down to point and scampers through as there is no fielder placed close by.
Back of a length, outside off. Tom Blundell defends it on his toes.
FOUR! Nicely played! It is short, around middle. Tom Blundell stays back and pulls it through square leg. He does enough to keep the ball grounded and sees it racing towards the boundary.
Tossed up, full and on off. Daryl Mitchell blocks it watchfully. New Zealand lead by 162 runs now.
On middle and leg, tucked to the on side.
Floated and full, around leg. Daryl Mitchell goes for the sweep again but this time is unable to clear Jamie Overton at short fine leg.
On off, defended back to the bowler on the front foot.
FOUR! Swept away nicely. It is full and outside off. Daryl Mitchell gets down on one knee and sweeps it from outside off towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Looped up, around off. Daryl Mitchell defends it to the leg side.
5 dots in a row to end the over. This is on a length, around off. Tom Blundell defends it out.
Good comeback by Overton. Short ball, on top of off. Blundell stays inside the crease and digs it out.
This very full just outside off. Tom Blundell digs it out to backward point.
Length ball, outside off, shapes in a touch. Tom Blundell stays back and defends it out watchfully.
Full length, around off. Blundell eases it towards mid on.
FOUR! A loosener to start with. Full length, angling down leg. Tom Blundell stays back and flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Bowling changes from both sides as Jamie Overton comes in from this end.
Just a single of the over! It is full and on off. Daryl Mitchell blocks it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Mitchell goes back and dabs it towards point.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Mitchell presses forward and blocks it to the on side.
Floated and full, around off. Daryl Mitchell blocks it on his front foot.
Looped up, around off, defended out.
Tossed up on middle, this is blocked back towards the bowler.
Jack Leach (13-5-26-1) comes back into the attack.
Four dots on the trot to end the over! Stuart Broad goes with the bouncer yet again, around off. Daryl Mitchell bends his knees and leaves it alone.
A sharp bouncer this time, on middle and leg. Daryl Mitchell ducks under it without any second thoughts.
Length, on off. Mitchell blocks it out.
Fraction short, on off. Daryl Mitchell is on his toes to defend it out.
Really good running! This is full and on off. Tom Blundell is forced to play at it this time. He digs it out to backward point and scampers across for a single.
Broad serves it full, outside off. Tom Blundell strides across and shoulders his arms at it.
On leg, Daryl Mitchell works it to the leg side. Potts records his fifth maiden of this innings.
Full-length delivery, on fifth stump. Daryl Mitchell leans in and drives it to covers. The fielder dives to his left to make a great stop.
Make it 4 now! Length ball, on off. Daryl Mitchell remains solid in his defense.
On a length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell defends it to point on the front foot. Three dots now. Potts has been clinical so far this morning.
Two dots in a row now! It is angled into the pads, on a length. Daryl Mitchell stays back, closes the face of the blade and blocks it towards mid on.
Potts angles it from outside off, but this one straightens after hitting the deck. Daryl Mitchell shows no interest to play away from his body.
Length, on the pads, Daryl Mitchell flicks it to square leg for one. A good over for the visitors, 7 runs off it.
Brilliant running this time! It is full, on middle and leg. Daryl Mitchell clips it to deep square leg and gets back for the second run.
Fuller, on off. Mitchell blocks it to the on side.

RIPPER! This one lands outside off and nips back in sharply. Daryl Mitchell is caught inside his crease and gets beaten on the inside edge. This is as close as it gets. Broad asking the right questions here.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full length, on middle and leg. Daryl Mitchell stays back and clips it through square leg for a boundary.

Great delivery to end the over! This time it is close to the batter but still did not force Blundell to play at it. It is on a length, in the corridor of uncertainty. Tom Blundell squares up a bit, as he shuffles across and tries to block it out. He keeps the blade close to the body, as the ball zips past the outside edge.
This is much fuller, outside off, shaping away a touch. Tom Blundell lets it go through.
Wide outside off yet again. Tom Blundell strides across and shoulders his arms at it.
This is touch shorter, wide outside off. Tom Blundell does not chase it at all.
On a length, on fifth stump. Tom Blundell presses forward and blocks it to the off side.
Good length, outside off, with a bit of movement. Tom Blundell leaves it alone.
Good shot but straight to the fielder. Full length, outside off. Daryl Mitchell connects sweetly and drives it to short extra cover. Could not find the gap.
Fuller in length, much straighter on off. Daryl Mitchell defends it back.
Ball change! The umpire walks towards the pavilion to pick a new ball as the box comes out.
Touch short, on off. Daryl Mitchell blocks it out.
Fraction short, way outside off. Daryl Mitchell shoulders his arms at it.
Full length this time, angled into the pads, Daryl Mitchell stays back and drives it towards mid on with soft-hands.
Length, around off. Daryl Mitchell blocks it to the on side.
A maiden for Matthew Potts. Full length, on off. Tom Blundell blocks it out.
Incredible bowling! This one angles in but straightens off the deck. Tom Blundell yet again defends inside the line and misses the ball completely.
BEATEN! Matthew Potts bowling with fire here. On a length, wide outside off. Blundell presses forward and tries to work it away but misses. He gets beaten on his outside edge.
Length ball, on off. Blundell flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Touch short, around the hips. Tom Blundell tucks it to the leg side.
Good length, wide outside off. Tom Blundell shoulders his arms at it.
Pulls his length back a bit on middle. Daryl Mitchell works it towards short mid-wicket. 2 maidens for Stuart Broad to begin proceedings!
Full once again on off, Sturdy defense back to the bowler from Daryl Mitchell.
Slightly full and angling in from outside off. Daryl Mitchell raises his hands and lets it through.
Goes fuller and on leg, Daryl Mitchell eases it straight towards the mid on fielder.
Stuart Broad bowls it on off this time, Daryl Mitchell defends it back to him.
This one lands shorter and outside off, Daryl Mitchell lets it go towards the keeper.
Good-length delivery outside off, Left alone by Tom Blundell.
Fuller on off stump, blocked towards covers.
FOUR! Tom Blundell gets the second boundary of the morning! Full and on off, Tom Blundell strides forward and guides it past short cover for a boundary!
Middle stump line on a good length, Tom Blundell knocks it down on the leg side.
Good-length delivery, angling in from outside off, Tom Blundell judges the line of the ball well and leaves it.
Matthew Potts delivers this slightly full and outside off stump. Tom Blundell not interested to play at it.
Fuller and outside off, Daryl Mitchell leaves this one for the keeper to collect.
Fraction shorter but still outside off. Daryl Mitchell shoulders arms to it.
Nice shape away from Daryl Mitchell. Stuart Broad bowls this on a good length outside off. Daryl Mitchell steps across towards the offside and hangs his bat out but gets beaten.
Good-length delivery outside off, Daryl Mitchell happy to leave this one alone.
Fuller this time and wider from off stump, Daryl Mitchell strides forward and hits it straight to short cover.
Stuart Broad starts with a full outside off. Daryl Mitchell defends back to the bowler.
FOUR! Potts starts with a length delivery on the pads, Blundell tucks it nicely through square leg and it races away to the fence. A perfect start for New Zealand.

The morning session on Day 4 is set to begin.The English players take the field. They are followed by Tom Blundell and Daryl Mitchell who walk out with their swords. It will be Matthew Potts to complete the over.

Just in, Ben Foakes has been ruled out of the Test series due to covid. He wasn't seen on the field as well on Day 3 as he had a stiff back and Jonny Bairstow donned the gloves on his behalf. Now, it has been confirmed Sam Billings will be Foakes direct replacement.

For New Zealand, it has to be the pair of Mitchell and Blundell yet again who have to bail them out of jail. The Kiwis would be wanting to stretch their lead to 250 at least. It is not going to be easy against an English bowling attack which is doing really well. The first session could decide a lot in this game. Welcome to the coverage.

What a series this has been as a neutral! All the games so far have been filled with excitement and this one is no less. Whenever England have had their backs against the wall they have come out fighting and so is the case here. After the top three for New Zealand took them into a strong position, they hosts’ bowlers fought back in the last session to take their side on top. The lead is just the 137 and they would know if they can break the current partnership, they can keep the Kiwis to a low score.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

The breaks just did not work for the visitors. There were a few rash shots from Williamson and Latham who were looking solid before and that has put them behind in the game. All that hard work before this session, first to not let England take a big lead and then to begin really well with the bat could go down the drain if Mitchell and Blundell do not come to the rescue, AGAIN. Will that happen? We will find out on Day 4. Do join us for all the action which begins at 03:30 PM IST (10:00 AM GMT). Till then goodbye and cheers!

And the inevitable has happened as Stumps has been called! That mini session after the break has turned the tide to England’s favor. Three wickets in it and the visitors have slipped from 152 for 2 to 168 for 5. Excellent from Potts who was the pick of the bowlers but he was well supported by Leach too.
The rain is quite steady at the moment, not heavy but steady, if we don’t get on by 10:49 PM IST (05:19 PM GMT), that will be Stumps. Difficult to see the play resuming again but fingers crossed.

10:30 PM IST (05:00 PM GMT) - Blundell moves away right at the end and Potts does not like that. However, the umpires decide the ask the covers to come on as the rain has gotten heavier. The England players walk off with big smiles on their faces as they know they have had a terrific mini session after the rain break.
This one lands on leg as well, Tom Blundell defends it solidly.
A yorker on leg, Tom Blundell looks to defend it but misses as the ball hits his toe. A loud shout but the finger stays down.
FOUR! Fuller one on middle and leg, Tom Blundell uses the pace of the ball and flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
On middle and fuller in length, this is guided towards the mid on fielder.
On a length and on middle, Tom Blundell defends it towards the mid on fielder.
This one lands fuller and on middle, Daryl Mitchell watchfully blocks it away.
Fuller and on middle, Tom Blundell flicks it towards the leg side for one.
On middle again, Tom Blundell looks to defend it but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards the leg gully.
Sticks to bowling it on middle, this is again defended back towards Jack Leach.
On middle this time, Tom Blundell blocks it off his front foot.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Daryl Mitchell nudges it towards the mid-wicket region for one.
Yorker length on off stump, Tom Blundell manages to dig this one out.
Good-length delivery bowled in line with the stump. Tom Blundell knocks it back to the bowler.
Fraction full on middle, Tom Blundell works it towards square leg.
Goes short angling into Daryl Mitchell who mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery on off. Daryl Mitchell punches it back and Matthew Potts catches the ball on his follow-through.
This one lands on the leg side, Tom Blundell defends it towards the leg side.
Who will walk out now? Tom Blundell is on the field to resume his flourishing partnership with Daryl Mitchell.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fuller one again with a hint of turn, Henry Nicholls comes forward to defend it but the ball hits the upper part of his bat and carries towards Jack Leach who takes a diving catch with his both hands. New Zealand has lost 5 wickets for just 161 now!
This is similar to the last delivery, this is again defended towards the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Henry Nicholls defends it back towards the bowler.
Fuller one on middle, blocked away.
On a full length and on middle, this is flicked towards the leg side for one.
Jack Leach (11-5-24-0) into the attack now.
Daryl Mitchell is off the mark. Fuller and on leg, Daryl Mitchell flicks it towards backward square leg for one.
Flicks a length ball towards the mid on fielder.
This is fuller and on middle, this is defended back towards the bowler.
Oh, that was close. On a length and on off, Daryl Mitchell looks to defend it but misses as the ball goes just past his blade and towards the keeper.
On a length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell guides it towards short cover.
Goes fuller and down the leg side, Daryl Mitchell defends it towards the fielder at mid on.
What a delivery to the end the over! On a good length just outside off, bowls from wide off the crease and makes the ball hold its line. Henry Nicholls is beaten all ends up.
Off stump line on a good length. Henry Nicholls defends it towards point.
Slightly full outside off, Henry Nicholls gets low and lets the ball pass through to the keeper.
Good-length delivery on off, Henry Nicholls gets across and defends solidly.
FOUR! That is beautifully timed by Henry Nicholls! Full on the pads, Henry Nicholls flicks it through the midwicket region for a boundary! England has conceded a lot of runs in that region!
Good-length delivery outside off. Defended back to the bowler.
Good outswinger outside off, Daryl Mitchell leaves this one well.
Full delivery angling in from outside off. Daryl Mitchell shuffles across and taps it towards the leg side.
Full this time angling into the pads, Henry Nicholls defends and gets an inside edge towards sqaure leg for a single.
Good-length delivery outside off, Henry Nicholls steps across and plays it firmly towards cover.
Full once again but closer to the batter. Henry Nicholls knocks it towards cover.
Full delivery holding its line outside off, Henry Nicholls leaves it for the keeper to collect.
Good-length delivery outside off, Daryl Mitchell watches it closely and leaves it alone.
Full outside off, Daryl Mitchell steps across and defends it confidently.
Full angled into the stumps, Henry Nicholls knocks it towards cover. Headingly is buzzing! They are pumped up and all the English players are joining in on the fun!
Not short enough to cut, and Henry Nicholls slashes at it and misses.
Fuller one this time on off, Henry Nicholls works it towards short mid-wicket fielder.
On a length and on middle, Henry Nicholls with a solid block off his front foot.
On a length and on leg, Daryl Mitchell defends it towards the leg side.
Who will walk out now? Daryl Mitchell is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Matthew Potts gets Kane Williamson fishing once again! Good-length delivery from outside off, Matthew Potts gets the ball to hold the line. Kane Williamson plays before the angle and gets a edge to Jonny Bairstow who has no trouble pouching this one! The skipper departs and New Zealand are falling apart after the rain interval! Matthew Potts has got Kane Williamson 3 out of 4 times in this series now.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Matthew Potts

Commentary.Commentary: Wide outside off, Kane Williamson not tempted to play at that one.
Full on middle, keeps a fraction low. Kane Williamson gets his bat down in time and plays it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery angled into the pads. Gets to Kane Williamson quicker then he expects and gets a leading edge to short cover.
Slightly back of a length on off, Kane Williamson rises up and fends it on the offside.
Wide delivery once again on a good length. Henry Nicholls happy to let this one go as well.
Slightly full and angled towards the leg side. Henry Nicholls tries to work it leg side but gets a leading edge towards cover.
Good-length delivery wide from off stump. Henry Nicholls shoulders arms to it.
Fraction full outside off, Henry Nicholls leaves it alone.
Back of a length outside off, Henry Nicholls covers the line of the ball and defends it solidly.
Stuart Broad bowls a good length delivery on off from round the wicket, Nicholls defends it solidly in the off side.
Fuller and on middle, this is flicked towards the leg side for one.
This is outside off with a hint of turn, left alone by Henry Nicholls.

OUT! CAUGHT! The break has worked once again! England strike on a restart once again! What a catch from Ollie Pope as he plucks it out of thin air. Good-length delivery on the middle, Conway tries to defend gets a thick inside edge towards short leg! New Zealand are three down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Ollie Pope b Joe Root

Commentary.Commentary: The covers are removed. Conway and Williamson will resume again. Joe Root comes to bowl.
09:19 PM IST (03:49 PM GMT) -  It has started to rain and the players are going off! The covers come on too. Should just be a passing shower though.

Full and going down leg stump, Devon Conway tries to work it fine but misses. So does Jonny Bairstow as he can not get down in time. Runs down to the fine leg boundary for four byes. The rain has gotten heavy and umpires ask the players to leave the field.
Short and wide, a little bit of an extra bounce. Kane Williamson works it to backward point for a single.
Starts with a tossed-up delivery outside off, Williamson defends it with a big stride forward.
Full and wide outside off. Devon Conway strides across once again and defends solidly.
Angled in from off stump, Devon Conway plays with soft hands towards cover.
On a good length outside off, Devon Conway goes on the backfoot and defends.
Full once again outside off, defended towards point.
On a length outside off, Conway leans forward and defends it.
Flights one full outside off to start off with. Devon Conway gets a long way across and defends it.
Jack Leach comes into the attack.
On a length and much fuller, Kane Williamson defends it off the front foot.
Shorter one again, much slower this time, Kane Williamson lets this one go as well.
Shorter one again and outside off, Kane Williamson lets it through and towards the keeper.
Shorter and outside off, Kane Williamson leaves it alone.
Jamie Overton serves a length ball on off, Kane Williamson blocks it towards the mid off fielder.
Shorter one outside off shaping it away, Kane Williamson leaves it alone towards the keeper.
Outside off again from Stuart Broad, left alone by Devon Conway.
Slightly shorter and just outside off, Devon Conway shoulders arms to it.
This one lands outside off, Devon Conway lets it through and towards the keeper.
Fuller one on leg, Devon Conway works it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Stuart Broad bowls it outside off, Devon Conway shoulders arms at it.
Outside off this time, Devon Conway drives it towards the short cover fielder who does a funny impression and throws the ball in the air.
FOUR! This one lands fuller and outside leg, Kane Williamson just gives a fine tickle to it as the ball races towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Shorter one this time, Kane Williamson leaves it alone towards the keeper.
On a length and outside leg, Kane Williamson looks to flick it but misses. A loud shout but the finger stays down.
On a length and outside leg, Kane Williamson leaves it alone.
This one lands fuller and on middle, Kane Williamson defends it away.
Shorter once again, Kane Williamson leaves it alone. Oh, its a no ball.

Oh, this was close. Shorter and on middle, Devon Conway pulls it towards square leg where Ben Stokes makes a diving effort to catch it but just gets his fingertips at it and goes towards deep square leg. They rotate the strike.
On a length and on off, Kane Williamson guides it towards the mid off fielder.
Outside off this time, left alone by Kane Williamson.
This one lands fuller and on middle, Kane Williamson defends it away.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Kane Williamson looks to defend it but gets a thick outside edge as the ball races towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Oh, that was close! On a length and just outside off, Kane Williamson looks to block it but misses. The ball just aired past his bat and into the gloves of the keeper.
Fuller one on middle, this one is lower, Kane Williamson blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! Shorter one outside off, Devon Conway waits for the ball and plays a late cut towards third man. The ball goes behind the fence for a boundary.
Goes fuller and down the middle, Devon Conway eases it back towards Jamie Overton.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Kane Williamson flicks it towards square leg for one.
Wayward bouncer from Jamie Overton, Kane Williamson leaves it alone towards the keeper.
This one lands on a length as well, Kane Williamson defends it back towards Jamie Overton.
On a length and on middle, Kane Williamson looks to flick it but gets an outside edge as the ball rolls towards the vacant silly point region.
Bowls this fraction back of a length outside off. Gets an extra bit of bounce from the surface and Devon Conway gets on top of this and works it down to his feet.
Full and outside off, Kane Williamson uses his wrists and works it towards square leg for a single.
Good delivery from Stuart Broad as he beats Kane Williamson on his outside edge. Just outside off on a good length, moves away from the batter.
Slightly full on off, Kane Williamson taps it on the offside.
Good-length delivery outside off. Fended towards point.
Loose delivery to start off with for Stuart Broad. Bowls this full and really wide from off stump. Kane Williamson does not bother with it.
Stuart Broad comes into the attack.
Slightly back of a length outside off, Devon Conway works this through cover-point for a couple of runs.
On a good length and down the middle, this is defended off the front foot.
FOUR! An unconvincing shot to get off the mark! Jamie Overton goes a touch fuller outside off, Devon Conway hangs his bat out and get a thick outside edge past the slip cordon for a boundary!
Back-of-a-length delivery aimed for the batter. Devon Conway tries to pull and gets hit on the body this time.

Devon Conway gets a hit on his helmet. The physio is out in the middle for the concussion tests. The helmet will be replaced and he should be ready to face the next ball. There is a slight delay as the helmet is being taped. Now we are finally set to resume.
Jamie Overton is on fire here! What a first ball to Devon Conway as he bangs it in short and the ball thuds against his helmet. Completely floors the batter.
Who will walk out now? Devon Conway is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Jamie Overton strikes right after tea! Bowls this on a good length just outside off, gets lovely shape away from Tom Latham who had been playing beautifully before the break. Gets an outside edge straight to Jonny Bairstow who takes an easy catch! What a start for England!
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Jamie Overton

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the final session of Day 3! England players have made their way out in the middle. Latham and Williamson will resume their innings. Jamie Overton comes to bowl.
… DAY 3, SESSION 3 …

The England bowlers were really good for the initial part of the session but later on, there were far too many loose balls which let the Kiwis score freely. They’ll need to first stem the run flow and then look to take wickets or they’ll be chasing a big total. An important session awaits, do join us in a bit.

That’s a really good session for the visitors and for now, they are in the ascendancy In this game. The start though was not the best as they lost Young early after Lunch but since then, it has been all New Zealand. Latham and Williamson have looked solid and are amidst an excellent stand. Both have their eye in and now need to make most of it. The lead is nearing a 100 but New Zealand will know they need to keep batting as long as they can.
Goes a little fuller outside off. Kane Williamson watches it carefully and lets it through to the keeper. The umpires have decided that it shall be Tea on DAY 3.
Good-length delivery on off. Kane Williamson gets forward and defends firmly.
Slightly closer to the stumps this time on a good length. Kane Williamson judges it well and leaves it alone.
Stuart Broad bowls this one wide from off stump on a good length. Kane Williamson leaves it alone.
Full on off stump. Kane Williamson knocks it back to the bowler who parries it towards mid off.
FOUR! Fraction short and on middle. Kane Williamson rolls his wrist and pulls it wide of deep square leg for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, Latham defends it off the front foot.
Goes fuller again, Tom Latham defends it away solidly.
Fuller and on middle, this is defended off the front foot.
FOUR! This one lands outside leg, Latham uses the pace of the ball and flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Goes outside off with a hint of turn, Latham looks to defend it but misses.
Full and outside off, pushes it past cover for a single.
This was similar to the last delivery, Latham again leaves it through and towards the keeper.
Goes outside off this time, Latham leaves it alone.

DROPPED! Joe Root has dropped a sitter! Stuart Broad brought back into the attack almost delivered for England, but some ordinary catching has given Tom Latham an extra life! Stuart Broad bowls this full outside off. Tom Latham has been timing it well and decides to go after this one but only manages to get an outside edge towards first slip. Joe Root at first slip goes on one knee to catch this but the ball drops from his hand! What a let off for New Zealand!
Full outside off this time. Tom Latham leaves this one alone.
Full and angling onto the pads once again. Tom Latham works this to square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Stuart Broad follows suit and continues to feed Tom Latham on his pads! Full and Tom Latham once again places it towards the mid-wicket boundary!
Shorter this time outside off. Kane Williamson goes back and works it towards short third man.
Good-length delivery on leg, plays it towards short leg.
Full outside off stump, Kane Williamson goes forward and defends well.
Full once again and sticks to the middle stump line, Kane Williamson defends towards point.
Fuller on middle, Kane Williamson works it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted on a good length outside off, Kane Williamson leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery this time outside off. Tom Blundell solid in defense as he plays it towards covers.
Full and angling in from off stump. Tom Latham gets forward and strokes it towards mid off.
Fraction fuller outside off, Tom Latham knocks it towards short cover.
Good-length delivery on off, Tom Latham defends this towards mid on.
On a good length this time outside off, Tom Latham leaves this one alone.

FOUR! Ben Stokes has got his length all wrong here! Coming from around the wicket bowls it full on the pads all over again. Tom Latham is happy to work this towards mid-wicket and get himself four more runs.
Good-length delivery on middle. Kane Williamson goes back and knocks it towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off with a hint of turn, Kane Williamson gets in two minds but leaves it alone in the end.
Tossed up on leg, Kane Williamson guides it towards the fielder at short leg.
This one lands outside off, Kane Williamson defends it with soft hands towards the off side.
Fuller and on middle, Kane Williamson defends it back towards Jack Leach.
On off, defended out.
Straying down leg side once again, Tom Latham flicks this square this time straight to the fielder at square leg.
Ben Stokes finally gets it right. Good-length delivery just outside off, swings away from Tom Latham and beats him all ends up.
Full outside off, worked towards covers.

FOUR! That is an action replay! Ben Stokes is bwling too full and angling down leg. Tom Latham is timing the ball wonderfully and manages to pierce the gap between mid-wicket and mid on for the second boundary of the over.
FOUR! Great timing from Tom Latham! Ben Stokes goes full on the pads looking for swing. Does not find any and Tom Latham flicks this easily through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Good-length delivery from over the wicket, angling into Tom Latham. He fends it towards point.
Ben Foakes has returned to the hotel due to a stiff back. Harry Brook comes in as a subsitute fielder, while Jonny Bairstow continues to do his work behind the sticks.
FOUR! Jack Leach goes short and wide, Kane Williamson gets low and cuts this through point for a boundary! Kane Williamson getting a move on now and is looking good!
Flighted on off stump. Kane Williamson defends this towards cover.
Tossed up outside off, Kane Williamson drives it towards covers and scampers through for a single. Direct hit on the stumps and the ball rolls towards third man. Two runs taken.
Flighted up on middle, Kane Williamson eases it towards the short leg fielder.
Fuller and on middle, this is blocked out solidly.
Tossed up on middle, Kane Williamson punches it towards the cover fielder.

OUT! CAUGHT! Matthew Potts draws the first blood. Will Young could not find his feet and perishes at a timid score. He is not happy with himself. This is full, outside off. The afternoon session is set to begin. The England players stride out to the middle. Followed by Tom Latham and Will Young who walk out with their swords. Matthew Potts to start with the ball.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

England started the moving day briskly. They dominated the opening hour of the session, although could not continue in the same manner. Even though they lost Overton early on, Broad showed attacking intent with the blade straightaway that helped them to put on a small but an effective lead of 31 runs with the help of the tail-enders. Bairstow missed out on his double century but he did play his part to get his side back in the mix. New Zealand seamers on the other hand, ended the innings on a solid note, as they took the final three wickets in quick succession to let their batters out before the Lunch break. The afternoon session will be very interesting with both teams giving it a go to put their noses in front. Do join us at 6.10 pm IST (12.40 pm GMT) to find out how things pan out.

New Zealand are 18 runs behind. They have managed to remain unscathed as the players make their way out for the Lunch break. Latham scored all the runs so far, while Will Young is yet to get off the mark. Nevertheless, England look to be the happier side with the way they have came back on the field. They will be hoping to increase the tempo in the afternoon session, as they hardly troubled the batters in these 5 overs.
